description: This dataset is the long-term record of the SIAAP Observatory of the city, which monitors the quality of Paris wastewater at the Clichy pretreatment plant, the collection point for about 2.7 million inhabitants. It holds monthly analyses since 2000 of usual physico-chemical parameters, trace metals, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and PCBs in dry-weather wastewater, and the same parameters for 384 rain events since 2005 relevant to combined sewer overflows, with a table of analytical methods and a data paper. SIAAP, the Greater Paris Sanitation Authority, produced it with ISA Lyon and LEESU and publishes it on Zenodo as Excel files, available as a free download under CC BY 4.0, with a new release planned every two years (this one June 2022). Coverage is one city catchment. Caveats: it covers one inlet only, and sampling is monthly or per event, not continuous. Simulation uses: influent loads and wet weather pollutant concentrations for treatment capacity planning, CSO hazard exposure and sewer digital twins. Related records: JRC domestic waste emissions (data-jrc-domestic-waste-emissions-european-freshwaters-2010s) and Cerema's Oasis stormwater design tool (model-cerema-oasis-stormwater-infiltration-design).
